name: Architecture Tournament with Minority-Report Fold-In
description: Generate N genuinely independent architectures, then run them head-to-head in a pairwise bracket scored on a rubric FROZEN before generation, so the winner beats a rival rather than a blank page. Three properties make this more than a beauty contest: a critical error eliminates in round one instead of being averaged away, a champion must beat its rival on a NAMED dimension, and the minority report of what the losers did better is mandatory and is folded back into the champion.

n_architectures.description: How many independent architectures to generate

rubric_weights.description: dimension -> weight, FROZEN before S1; mutating it after generation is the failure this blueprint exists to prevent

critical_error_dimensions.description: Dimensions on which a zero is fatal rather than merely low-scoring

constraints.description: Hard constraints every architecture must satisfy

architect.description: Produces ONE architecture in isolation, blind to every sibling's output

bracket_judge.description: Scores one pair on the frozen rubric and must name the deciding dimension

cross_vendor_judge.description: Second judge from another vendor, so a shared blind spot cannot decide the bracket

minority_writer.description: Writes what each eliminated architecture did better, and what must be folded in

owner.description: Decides whether the tournament cost is warranted for this decision size

routes.reason: cross-vendor diversity on the judging seat, not only on the generating seat

stages.title: S0 FIX the rubric and weights, and hash them
S1 GENERATE N architectures in isolation

work_unit.title: Produce one architecture without seeing any sibling
work_unit.question_or_target: Design one complete architecture for the stated problem, scoring itself against no rubric dimension it invented.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: independent generation demands maximum effort per lens

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every design claim anchors to a repo fact or an external source; a claim with neither is marked UNVERIFIED inline
tests_required: an architecture whose fingerprint equals a sibling's must be re-run with a different seed constraint
an architecture violating a declared constraint must be rejected before scoring
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: two bracket judges, one of them cross-vendor; never the sibling architects
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC01-S1 only when the dossier declares a fingerprint and satisfies every declared constraint; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC01-S1 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to a different seed constraint rather than a third identical run

stages.title: S1b CHECK independence - a near-duplicate is a failed lens, not a consensus
S2 BRACKET: pairwise comparisons on the frozen rubric

work_unit.title: Judge one bracket round on the frozen rubric
work_unit.question_or_target: For each pair, compute the weighted score, apply the critical-error override, and name the deciding dimension.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: scoring is arithmetic over declared scores; the judgement is only in assigning the scores

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every round records both weighted totals, the deciding dimension, and what the loser scored higher on
tests_required: a deliberately fatal architecture must be eliminated in round one by the critical-error override, not out-scored on average
a round whose winner names no deciding dimension must FAIL
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the cross-vendor judge re-scores any round decided by less than one rubric point
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC01-S2 only when each round names a deciding dimension and records the loser's better dimensions; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC01-S2 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then pivot to explicit re-scoring by the cross-vendor judge

stages.title: S2 gate: a champion must beat a rival on a NAMED dimension
S3 WRITE the minority report of what the losers did better

work_unit.title: Record every dimension on which an eliminated architecture beat the champion
work_unit.question_or_target: Enumerate the losers' wins and propose, per win, whether it can be folded into the champion.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: informed rather than independent - this role must read every dossier

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each entry names the losing architecture, the dimension, and the score gap that justifies the claim
tests_required: a bracket in which some loser scored higher on some dimension must produce a non-empty minority report
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the cross-vendor judge checks that no loser win was omitted
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC01-S3 only when every dimension on which a loser out-scored the champion appears in the report; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC01-S3 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry then escalate; discarding the losers is not an acceptable outcome

stages.title: S4 FOLD the minority report's wins into the champion

work_unit.title: Fold each accepted minority win into the champion architecture
work_unit.question_or_target: Produce the champion-plus-fold-in dossier, recording for each minority win whether it was folded in and why.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the fold-in is what makes a tournament worth more than a single design council

work_unit.evidence_requirement: every minority win carries an explicit folded_in true/false with a reason
tests_required: a champion dossier that records no fold-in decision for a listed minority win must FAIL
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the owner, who is the only role that can accept the champion
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:BP3-ARC01-S4 only when every minority win has an explicit folded_in decision with a reason; otherwise FAILED:BP3-ARC01-S4 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: one retry then escalate to the owner

stages.title: S4 gate: the minority report and its fold-in decisions both exist
S4b gate the champion dossier on the shared 12-condition predicate

stopping_rules.expression: champion_selected == true AND minority_report_written == true AND fold_in_decisions_recorded == true

impact.blast_radius: writes only under command-center/tournament/**; produces a design decision, no code

x_extensions.owner_decision: OPEN: is a tournament worth 3-5x a single design council at this estate's typical decision size? Recorded here rather than silently answered.
x_extensions.distinguishing_mechanism: pairwise bracket over GENERATED candidates with a critical-error override and a mandatory minority-report fold-in. BP-PLN-01 gates ONE artifact; this one selects among several and then re-imports what the losers did better.

worked_example.name: a fatal candidate eliminated in round one
worked_example.narrative: Four architectures are scored on a two-dimension frozen rubric. 'alpha' carries a critical error (it stores a credential in the repo) and is eliminated before any averaging. 'delta' is a near-duplicate of 'beta', which is an independence failure. Of the survivors the champion must name the dimension that decided its win, and 'gamma' beat it on recoverability, which must appear in the minority report.

architectures.name: alpha
critical_errors: stores a credential in the repo

controls.why: the override is doing the work - without it the fatal design wins on score
